realtime.targets.topic: Label of the MQTT topic field of the message composer. Keep it short.
realtime.targets.event: Label of the Socket.IO event name field of the message composer. Keep it short.
realtime.browser.closed: Entry of the message log. {{code}} is a WebSocket close code.
realtime.browser.closedWithReason: {{code}} is a WebSocket close code; {{reason}} is text from the server.
realtime.browser.notConnected: Entry of the message log when the connection could not be opened. {{code}} is a WebSocket close code.
realtime.browser.notConnectedWithReason: {{code}} is a WebSocket close code; {{reason}} is text from the server.
realtime.graphql.subscribing: Log entry of a GraphQL subscription over WebSocket.
realtime.graphql.complete: Log entry: the server ended the subscription.
realtime.socketIo.joined: {{namespace}} is a Socket.IO namespace such as /chat.
realtime.socketIo.ack: Label of a Socket.IO acknowledgement. {{id}} is its number. Keep ack.
realtime.mqtt: Log entries of an MQTT connection. The broker is the MQTT server.
realtime.mqtt.refusedOther: {{code}} is a numeric MQTT return code.
